scripts.title: ESP, Aimbot & Silent Aim | Vehicle ESP | Free, No Key
scripts.features:
ESP, aimbot and silent aim for Cold War [VIETNAM], the 80-player NATO vs PACT shooter. Open the panel with RightShift and switch on what you want.

FEATURES
- ESP: box, name, class (Sniper, AT, Machinegun, Medic ...), weapon, distance in meters, a health bar built from all six limbs, head and torso health, skeleton, tracers and head dot
- Status flags DOWNED, SPAWN, DISGUISED and VEHICLE, a wall check that highlights visible enemies, teammates optional
- Vehicle ESP for enemy vehicles, judged by the crew's team, so captured vehicles show up on the right side
- Aimbot: a camera aimbot that compensates bullet drop and leads moving targets with the game's own ballistics. FOV circle, sticky target, visible only, a humaniser (reaction delay, wind-up, speed ceiling) and a panic key
- Silent aim: bends your real shot onto enemies only, never teammates, and only when the bullet can really reach them. Head / Torso / Nearest / Random, FOV in degrees, hit chance and lead. Off by default
- World: no fog, fullbright, no suppression blur
- Info: tickets, your K/D and a staff detector

MOBILE
Works on PC and mobile - the panel asks once and scales itself, in German, English and Russian.

HOW TO RUN
1. Open Cold War [VIETNAM]
2. Paste the loader into your executor
3. Execute - the panel opens by itself
4. Press RightShift to show or hide it

No key, no ads, and it never spends Robux.

Open source, read it before you run it:
https://github.com/seltonmt012/sel01-rbx/blob/main/games/coldwar.lua
Discord: https://discord.gg/ARdpzFuKMm

scripts.features: So basically this code only works in Part 1 and when you execute it, it automatically enters the code in the elevator lock and unlocks the code lock (open source)
scripts.script:
--Insta code
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local digitsLabel = Workspace:WaitForChild("monochrome"):WaitForChild("CodeNote"):WaitForChild("Printed"):WaitForChild("Digits")
local keypadFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("monochrome"):WaitForChild("Keypad")

local cleanCode = string.gsub(digitsLabel.Text, "%D", "")

if #cleanCode == 4 then
	task.wait(0.5)

	for index = 1, 4 do
		local digitValue = tonumber(string.sub(cleanCode, index, index))
		local digitPart = keypadFolder:FindFirstChild("Digit" .. index)

		if digitPart then
			local clickDetector = digitPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
			if clickDetector then
				for i = 1, digitValue do
					fireclickdetector(clickDetector)
					task.wait(0.15)
				end
			end
		end

		task.wait(0.4)
	end
end

scripts.script:
-- [[ Rscripts Risk Notice ]]
-- This script is not verified by rscripts.net. Deal with caution.
--
-- Stay safe:
--   • Never log in on unofficial Roblox sites or lookalike domains.
--   • Real Roblox links use roblox.com (check the .com ending).
--   • Treat fake Roblox login / "claim reward" pages as phishing.
-- [[ End Rscripts Risk Notice ]]

-- Rooms: Revisited Parody — Cheat Menu (v15)
-- LocalScript → StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService     = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting         = game:GetService("Lighting")

local player    = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ============================================================
-- НАСТРОЙКИ
-- ============================================================
local CONFIG = {
	openKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,

	entities = {
		["A-60"]   = { color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40),   label = "A-60 — Multi Monster" },
		["A-60b"]  = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 20),   label = "A-60b — Multi Bounder" },
		["A-70"]   = { color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 60, 180),  label = "A-70 — Locker Mimic" },
		["A-90"]   = { color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 60),  label = "A-90 — Paralysis" },
		["A-90b"]  = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0),   label = "A-90b — Sensation" },
		["A-200"]  = { color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255), label = "A-200 — Happy Scribble" },
	},
	blacklist = {
		["A200Fakeout"]            = true,
		["fakesounda60"]           = true,
		["fakesounda200"]          = true,
		["FakeToolViewFlashlight"] = true,
	},

	spawnFolder = nil,
	duration    = 4.5,
	playSound   = true,
	soundId     = "rbxassetid://4550994248",
	volume      = 0.6,

	doorTargetName = "DoorSign",
	doorDotColor   = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
	doorDotSize    = 15,

	flySpeedMin  = 1, flySpeedMax  = 5,
	loopSpeedMin = 1, loopSpeedMax = 100,
	fovMin       = 30, fovMax      = 120,
}

local SETTINGS = {
	doorESP = true, notifications = true,
	fly = false, noclip = false,
	loopSpeed = false, instantPrompts = false, loopFOV = false,
	fullbright = false, nofog = false,
}

local VALUES = { flySpeed = 3, loopSpeed = 16, fov = 70 }

-- Forward declarations
local flyUpBtn, flyDownBtn
local noclipActive = false
local flyActive = false
local flyBV

local function getHumanoid()
	local char = player.Character
	return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

-- ============================================================
-- 1. DOT ESP (зелёная точка на дверях)
-- ============================================================
local dotESP = {}

local function getObjPos(obj)
	if obj:IsA("Model") then
		return obj:GetPivot().Position
	elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
		return obj.Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function addDot(obj, color, size)
	if dotESP[obj] then return end
	local pos = getObjPos(obj)
	if not pos then return end

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "DotESP"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.MaxDistance = 9999
	gui.Adornee = obj
	gui.Parent = obj

	local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
	dot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = color
	dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	dot.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = dot

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = dot

	dotESP[obj] = gui

	obj.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			if dotESP[obj] then
				dotESP[obj]:Destroy()
				dotESP[obj] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function removeDot(obj)
	if dotESP[obj] then
		dotESP[obj]:Destroy()
		dotESP[obj] = nil
	end
end

local function clearDoorDots()
	for obj, gui in pairs(dotESP) do
		if gui then gui:Destroy() end
		dotESP[obj] = nil
	end
end

local function scanDoorDots()
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj.Name == CONFIG.doorTargetName and (obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart")) then
			addDot(obj, CONFIG.doorDotColor, CONFIG.doorDotSize)
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================================
-- 2. УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ (V1 стиль, правый нижний угол)
-- ============================================================
local function showNotification(entityName)
	local cfg = CONFIG.entities[entityName]
	if not cfg then return end

	local screen = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RoomsNotifier")
	if not screen then
		screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		screen.Name = "RoomsNotifier"
		screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
		screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		screen.Parent = playerGui
	end

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Panel"
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 64)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -380, 1, 20)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Parent = screen

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = panel

	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Name = "Bar"
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, 0)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = cfg.color
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bar.Parent = panel
	local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
	barCorner.Parent = bar

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 6)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = cfg.label
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 17
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = panel

	local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	sub.Name = "Sub"
	sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
	sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 36)
	sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sub.Text = "Entity has spawned — hide!"
	sub.TextColor3 = cfg.color
	sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	sub.TextSize = 13
	sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	sub.Parent = panel

	if CONFIG.playSound then
		local sfx = Instance.new("Sound")
		sfx.SoundId = CONFIG.soundId
		sfx.Volume = CONFIG.volume
		sfx.Parent = panel
		sfx:Play()
	end

	local inTween = TweenService:Create(
		panel,
		TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Position = UDim2.new(1, -380, 1, -84) }
	)
	inTween:Play()

	task.delay(CONFIG.duration, function()
		local outTween = TweenService:Create(
			panel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(1, -380, 1, 20) }
		)
		outTween:Play()
		outTween.Completed:Connect(function()
			panel:Destroy()
		end)
	end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- 3. FULLBRIGHT / NOFOG
-- ============================================================
local lightOrig = {
	Brightness     = Lighting.Brightness,
	ClockTime      = Lighting.ClockTime,
	Ambient        = Lighting.Ambient,
	OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
	GlobalShadows  = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
	FogEnd         = Lighting.FogEnd,
	FogStart       = Lighting.FogStart,
}
local function setFullbright(on)
	if on then
		Lighting.Brightness = 3
		Lighting.ClockTime = 14
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	else
		Lighting.Brightness = lightOrig.Brightness
		Lighting.ClockTime = lightOrig.ClockTime
		Lighting.Ambient = lightOrig.Ambient
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = lightOrig.OutdoorAmbient
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = lightOrig.GlobalShadows
	end
end
local function setNoFog(on)
	if on then
		Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
		Lighting.FogStart = 100000
	else
		Lighting.FogEnd = lightOrig.FogEnd
		Lighting.FogStart = lightOrig.FogStart
	end
end

-- ============================================================
-- 4. FLY
-- ============================================================
local function startFly()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	flyBV.Name = "FlyVelocity"
	flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	flyBV.Parent = hrp
	flyActive = true
end

local function stopFly()
	flyActive = false
	if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy() flyBV = nil end
end

local mobileUpHeld, mobileDownHeld = false, false

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not flyActive then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (hrp and hum) then return end
	if not flyBV or flyBV.Parent ~= hrp then startFly() end
	local move = hum.MoveDirection
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or mobileUpHeld then
		move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or mobileDownHeld then
		move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	flyBV.Velocity = move * (VALUES.flySpeed * 30)
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 5. NOCLIP
-- ============================================================
local function applyNoclip()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end

local function applyClip()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = true
		end
	end
end

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if noclipActive then applyNoclip() end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	if flyActive then task.wait(0.3) startFly() end
	if noclipActive then task.wait(0.3) applyNoclip() end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 6. LOOP SPEED / LOOP FOV
-- ============================================================
local origFOV = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView or 70

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if SETTINGS.loopSpeed then
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = VALUES.loopSpeed end
	end
	if SETTINGS.loopFOV then
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then cam.FieldOfView = VALUES.fov end
	end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 7. INSTANT PROXIMITY PROMPTS
-- ============================================================
local function applyInstantPrompts()
	for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			if p:GetAttribute("origHold") == nil then
				p:SetAttribute("origHold", p.HoldDuration)
				p:SetAttribute("origDist", p.MaxActivationDistance)
			end
			p.HoldDuration = 0
			p.MaxActivationDistance = math.max(p.MaxActivationDistance, 20)
		end
	end
end

local function restorePrompts()
	for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and p:GetAttribute("origHold") ~= nil then
			p.HoldDuration = p:GetAttribute("origHold")
			p.MaxActivationDistance = p:GetAttribute("origDist")
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================================
-- 8. ДЕТЕКТ СУЩНОСТЕЙ + УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ
-- ============================================================
local seen = {}
local watchRoot = CONFIG.spawnFolder or workspace

local function isFake(obj)
	if CONFIG.blacklist[obj.Name] then return true end
	if obj.Name:lower():find("fake") then return true end
	return false
end

local function checkInstance(obj)
	if SETTINGS.doorESP and obj.Name == CONFIG.doorTargetName
		and (obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart")) then
		addDot(obj, CONFIG.doorDotColor, CONFIG.doorDotSize)
	end

	if SETTINGS.instantPrompts and obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
		if obj:GetAttribute("origHold") == nil then
			obj:SetAttribute("origHold", obj.HoldDuration)
			obj:SetAttribute("origDist", obj.MaxActivationDistance)
		end
		obj.HoldDuration = 0
		obj.MaxActivationDistance = math.max(obj.MaxActivationDistance, 20)
	end

	local name = obj.Name
	if isFake(obj) then return end

	if CONFIG.entities[name] or (name:match("^A%-%d+") and obj:IsA("Model")) then
		if seen[obj] then return end
		seen[obj] = true

		if not CONFIG.entities[name] then
			CONFIG.entities[name] = {
				color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 30, 30),
				label = name .. " — Unknown Entity",
			}
		end

		if SETTINGS.notifications then
			showNotification(name)
		end

		obj.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if parent == nil then
				seen[obj] = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- ==========================================
-- НАСТРОЙКИ
-- ==========================================

local highlightColor = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
local rotationSpeed = 5

local isHighlighting = false
local isAimbotEnabled = false
local highlights = {}

-- ==========================================
-- FLY
-- ==========================================

local isFlying = false
local flySpeed = 50

local bodyVelocity
local bodyGyro
local flyConnection

local function startFly()
    if isFlying then
        return
    end

    isFlying = true

    local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Name = "ModMenuFlyVelocity"
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bodyVelocity.Parent = root

    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.Name = "ModMenuFlyGyro"
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.Parent = root

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not isFlying then
            return
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

        if not camera or not root or not root.Parent then
            return
        end

        local direction = Vector3.zero

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            direction += camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            direction -= camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            direction -= camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            direction += camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            direction += Vector3.yAxis
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            direction -= Vector3.yAxis
        end

        if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
            direction = direction.Unit * flySpeed
        end

        bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction
        bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    isFlying = false

    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end

    if bodyVelocity then
        bodyVelocity:Destroy()
        bodyVelocity = nil
    end

    if bodyGyro then
        bodyGyro:Destroy()
        bodyGyro = nil
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- ESP
-- ==========================================

local function addHighlight(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    if highlights[player] then
        return
    end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "ModMenuHighlight"
    highlight.FillColor = highlightColor
    highlight.OutlineColor = highlightColor
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent = character

    highlights[player] = highlight
end

local function removeHighlight(player)
    if highlights[player] then
        highlights[player]:Destroy()
        highlights[player] = nil
    end
end

local function removeAllHighlights()
    for player, highlight in pairs(highlights) do
        if highlight then
            highlight:Destroy()
        end

        highlights[player] = nil
    end
end

local function toggleHighlights()
    isHighlighting = not isHighlighting

    if isHighlighting then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            addHighlight(player)
        end
    else
        removeAllHighlights()
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- ИГРОКИ / РЕСПАВН
-- ==========================================

local function setupPlayer(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if isHighlighting then
            task.wait(0.2)
            addHighlight(player)
        end
    end)
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    setupPlayer(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    removeHighlight(player)
end)

-- ==========================================
-- AIMBOT
-- ==========================================

local function getNearestEnemy()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not character then
        return nil
    end

    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not rootPart then
        return nil
    end

    local closestPlayer = nil
    local closestDistance = math.huge

    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= LocalPlayer and otherPlayer.Character then

            local otherRoot =
                otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local humanoid =
                otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if otherRoot and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then

                local distance =
                    (otherRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude

                if distance < closestDistance then
                    closestDistance = distance
                    closestPlayer = otherPlayer
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closestPlayer
end

local cameraConnection

local function startAimbot()
    if cameraConnection then
        cameraConnection:Disconnect()
    end

    cameraConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)

        if not isAimbotEnabled then
            return
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

        if not camera then
            return
        end

        local targetPlayer = getNearestEnemy()

        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then

            local targetRoot =
                targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if targetRoot then

                local camPos = camera.CFrame.Position
                local targetPos = targetRoot.Position

                local offset = targetPos - camPos

                if offset.Magnitude > 0 then

                    local direction = offset.Unit
                    local currentLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector

                    local newLook = currentLook:Lerp(
                        direction,
                        math.clamp(rotationSpeed * dt, 0, 1)
                    )

                    camera.CFrame =
                        CFrame.new(camPos, camPos + newLook)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ПЕРЕМЕЩЕНИЕ МЕНЮ
-- ==========================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = MainFrame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()

            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

    if not dragging then
        return
    end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)
